principles: Preserve current URLs, labels, phone number, FareHarbor shortname, language-switching behavior, and footer legal/social links before visual redesign.
Header and footer are canonical shell modules, not page copy. Pages provide title/content/schema; shell provides orientation, trust, navigation, and booking access.
Navigation must be keyboard/touch accessible, crawlable as normal anchors, and understandable when JavaScript is unavailable.
AI/readability helpers (llms.txt, JSON-LD SiteNavigationElement, breadcrumbs) derive from the same canonical nav data as the rendered UI.

rules: submenu toggles are buttons or disclosure controls on mobile
phone/address are plain text plus links

navItem.label: visible label
navItem.href: absolute site-root path or external URL

acceptance_checks: Rendered header/footer match current content labels and hrefs unless a deliberate redirect fix is documented
Every page has one main landmark between header and footer
H1-H6 remain Open Sans Condensed Bold
Mobile nav screenshot shows no overlap through third-level rentals
Header/footer links pass internal route verifier
JSON-LD/SiteNavigationElement generated from navTree matches rendered anchors
